name: Andaz Maui at Wailea
insider_take: This oceanfront paradise sits on 15 acres of pristine Mokapu Beach, where ancient Hawaiian fishponds meet modern luxury in perfect harmony.
whats_special: The resort features the only infinity pools on Maui that flow directly to the ocean, plus it's built on sacred Hawaiian land where ali'i (royalty) once lived. The property showcases one of the world's largest collections of contemporary Hawaiian art, with over 300 pieces by local artists throughout the resort.
pro_tip: Book a Mokapu Beach Suite for direct beach access and priority reservations at Ka'ana Kitchen, helmed by James Beard Award winner Isaac Bancaco who sources 90% of ingredients from local Maui farms.
dont_miss: Snorkeling at Mokapu Beach's coral reef (right off the resort), sunset drinks at the rooftop Bumbye Beach Bar, and exploring the ancient Hawaiian fishponds on property. The weekly traditional Hawaiian blessing ceremony is a moving cultural experience exclusive to resort guests.
pros: Prime Wailea beachfront location with direct beach access
Modern luxury design with authentic Hawaiian cultural elements
Multiple infinity pools including adults-only rooftop pool
Exceptional dining options featuring local ingredients and farm-to-table cuisine
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury Wailea location
Limited on-site parking availability during peak seasons
